strings.en: I'll show you the secret art of sure/　victory and sure survival...!
The shadow of death hangs over you...!
I will strike down all who bar my path!
'A sword is not meant to be drawn'.../　But here, it cannot be helped.
Behold the might of the Super Fighter!
Heh heh... truly the battle of a lifetime.
Yokijin, I'll cut you down where you stand!
Behold the resolve of us Earthlings!
Alien, face me in fair combat!
Not yet! This is where it begins!
Time to push a little harder.
...It seems this old man's part ends here.
Hrrm... And here I am/　pushing these old bones to their limit.
Hey! Show your elders some respect!
That won't be enough/　to break my resolve!
Gah! To think you'd force me back...!!
I'm not one to fall to the likes of you!!
Ugh...! I'm not what I used to be.
My, my. Picking on an old man? How petty.
Nngh! They got inside my guard!
Ha ha ha! Don't make me laugh!
You've got real talent./　Why not come study under me?
Heh heh... Takes me back to my youth.
Mmm... My blood's starting to boil!
Can't you be gentler with an old man?
Hm...! Fine moves you've got there.
Oho, I let their movements/　distract me.
With skill like that... What a waste.
Hm, to think a Yokijin would latch onto me.
Your sword is fast enough... but you lack spirit.
There's more to the sword than swinging it.
Well, that's the wisdom of age.
I won't lose to young folk just yet!
I have my students to think of, after all.
Shall I give you a lesson or two?
Well, sometimes you need tricks like this.
Oh, I forgot I had a barrier.
I won't let that opening slip by.
You called for me, Sänger Sombold!
Kusuha, leave the rest to me!
Arado, you're rushing ahead too fast.
Raul, leave the rest to me!
Choukijin, I'll lend you my blade!
Pardon me while I cut in!
I won't let you lay a hand on my pupil!
That machine holds the soul/　of my ancestor, you see.
Hm... I've still got some fight left!
There is nothing I cannot cut!!
There is nothing my blade cannot cut!
If the sword stays sheathed, peace endures...!
But once drawn, it cleaves in one stroke!!
Behold the sword of divine speed!!
There is nothing my Zankantou cannot cut!
Take the fist of a super warrior!
An ill star twinkles above your head!
Now, go forth toward ill fortune.
Ketu and Rahu will send you to your end!
A fine blade, forged by my own hand...!
Now then, let's cut down the nue/　that leads the world astray!
Guided by the star Ketu, glimpse the hell below!
